findings.enumeration: exactly two effective generic assignments;  no assigned-credential hits, no dedicated-provider hits, no bearer-header hits and no Zulip-shaped key hits.  The other credential-noun bindings in the file receive None or a call result.

findings.runtime_handling: the credential itself is read at run time from a 0600 file, passed to a child process on standard input and written to a 0600 environment file;  no value is stored in this file.
